text.en:
After 1 second of aiming-down-sights (ADS) without firing:
35% Flinch Reduction until no longer ADS.

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

enhanced (
#e Aiming Down Sights timer is reduced.
)
text.zh-chs:
瞄准 1 秒后不射击：
-35% 后仰抖动，直到取消瞄准。

按下瞄准键即开始计时。

enhanced (
#e 减少触发所需时间。
)
